upper_arm_certificate.acceptance: Both pieces require a positive separating support gap at each candidate q.

certificate.description: min((arm_base union link1) dot n) - max((link5 union link6) dot n); positive certifies separating plane between complete original collision mesh convex hulls only
certificate.projection_convention: Each proxy stores vertices in its URDF link frame after collision origin and scene transforms. Compute T_arm_base_link_i from the stored joint1..6 origin then Rodrigues(axis,q). Set n_arm_base = R_arm_base_link5 @ axis_local_link5. Project transformed arm_base/link1 vertices and link5/link6 vertices onto n_arm_base; global rigid mounting cancels from the gap.
limitations: No physical calibration or motion authorization.
No all-configuration guarantee; recompute support gap for each candidate state.
Nonpositive support gap is inconclusive and must remain rejected.
Only complete arm_base/link1 against complete link5/link6 meshes; all other collision checks remain necessary.

split.crossing_triangles: complete crossing triangle included in both pieces

high.axis_source: face normal of the complete-triangle high-part hull, face 402

wrist_certificate.scope: Additional shoulder/wrist check only. Every part and the complete tool hull must be separated from the complete shoulder hulls; no sphere or mesh is reduced.
